messages:
maya: Quick sync: we need final decisions on tiers & add-ons for Apr launch. Main ask from sales: clearer limits + opt-in retention add-on.
ryan: Customer POC pushed us — they need dedicated capacity as a paid add-on, and per-tenant retention 1y/3y options.
sophia: From PD: must ship with UI in Console to configure limits per API key. Can't rely on manual ops.
dinesh: Engineering constraints: quota enforcement + metering must be in billing pipeline. ETA: 6 weeks for soft limits, 10 for hard throttles.
katie: Finance: suggested price bands: Developer $0, Team $199/mo 50k tokens, Business $2k/mo 1M tokens, Enterprise custom. Add-ons: Dedicated + Private + Extended retention.
ben: Can we unify naming? 'Free', 'Pro', 'Business', 'Enterprise'? :thinking:
maya: Prefer 'Developer', 'Team', 'Business', 'Enterprise' to align w/ docs. Also add 'Dedicated' as add-on.
ryan: @maya what about overage pricing? customers want predictable caps not surprise bills.
katie: Proposed overage: $0.0008/token after limit. Or soft throttling + upgrade nudges.
sophia: Launch criteria checklist:
```
- Console UI for tier config
- Billing API + metering
- Soft quota enforcement + logs
- Pricing page + docs
- Migration guide for existing customers
- E2E tests + canary
```
dinesh: If we cut Dedicated from launch, we can ship 4 weeks earlier.
maya: Decision: MVP excludes Dedicated. We ship 'Team' and 'Business' tiers + Enterprise custom. Dedicated as Q2 add-on. :white_check_mark: 
ryan: Sales ok but asks for contract constraint: dedicated must be available within 60 days of signed contract or credit back.
legal-bot: Legal: 60-day SLA request needs finance approval; propose 45 days standard.
katie: Finance + Legal: propose 'Target delivery 60 days; failure => credits up to 10% of monthly fee' — ok?
ben: Edge case: teams using embeddings heavy workloads will hit token-based limits quickly. Consider separate embedding quota or usage class.
sophia: Agree — suggest 'embedding units' separate metric; map to 1 embedding = X tokens for billing.
maya: Action items: @sophia build spec for per-product quotas; @dinesh confirm ETA; @katie finalize price bands; @ryan share sales commitments. Weekly checkpoint Thurs 11am.
ryan: I'll draft customer-facing FAQ w/ negotiating playbook.
dinesh: ETA update: soft limits in 3w, billing integration in 5w. Hard throttles + per-key UI in 9w.
maya: Ok. Marking MVP launch criteria: console + soft limits + docs + pricing page. Will schedule canary with 10 customers.
katie: Add-on pricing note: Observability retention tiers: 30d(incl), 90d +$150/mo, 365d +$600/mo. Call this 'Retention Pack'.
ryan: Also mention reserved capacity (Dedicated) minimum commit: $25k/mo in initial term? sales suggested.
maya: Flag: need engineering capacity estimate and infra cost model for Dedicated; @dinesh pls.
dinesh: Will provide cost model by next Tues.
sophia: One more: rollout rollback plan if quota enforcement causes high error rates — include automatic fallback to lower-res model.
maya: Good. If no objections, I'll lock pricing doc by EOD Friday.
ben: :+1:
ryan: I'll loop in a couple of anchor customers to validate price sensitivity.
maya: Thanks all. Closing thread here — will post PRD link when ready.
